content:
casey: Flagging a weird billing diff — customer baz-service saw ~0.15% extra token usage during a quota-enforced truncation incident. Root looks like midstream handoff + quota-triggered truncation + retry.

mei: Is this the same as the aggregator duplicate issue or a different class? Any logs?

casey: Different pattern. Sequence: request hits primary -> primary enforces tenant quota and truncates stream early (returns partial EOF) -> client retries -> router routes to secondary which replays overlapping tokens. Both truncation path and replay path get credited. Logs: 

```
[2026-03-21T03:14:12Z] session=nm_42 route=primary quota_check=deny reason=tenant_quota_until=2026-03-21T09:00:00Z truncation_offset=8192 tokens=64 label=quota-trigger
[2026-03-21T03:14:12Z] ledger.write session=nm_42 offset=8192 tokens=64 meta={route:primary,label:quota-trigger} counted=true
[2026-03-21T03:14:13Z] client retry -> routed to secondary route=secondary resume_offset=8192 replay_prefetch tokens=64
[2026-03-21T03:14:13Z] ledger.write session=nm_42 offset=8192 tokens=64 meta={route:secondary,label:replay} counted=true <-- duplicate
```

rohan: Oof. That explains finance alarms. Ledger uniqueness by write_id won't help since two writes come from different codepaths/generate ids.

ana: Two immediate ideas: 1) upstream router prevents replay if a write for (session,offset,label=quota-trigger) exists; 2) mark quota-induced writes as provisional and confirm only when the client-ack path occurs. Which is less invasive?

mei: Router-level suppression is tricky when you cross regions / have eventual routing tables; race windows are small but real. Provisional sounds safer. We can add `credit_state={provisional,confirmed}` and tag `credit_reason=quota-trigger|replay|aggregator`.

casey: If we go provisional, we must ensure quota enforcement still behaves: when primary truncates due to quota, the customer should see truncated response and not be blocked for replay; but billing should not double-count. So provisional writes shouldn't be included in billing until confirmed.

rohan: UX/billing implications: dashboards and summaries will show provisional credits floating, finance team will panic. Need console changes: a filter for `credit_state`, and an explanation tooltip for provisional credits. Also add a reconciliation query to find accounts with >0.2% provisional churn.

finance-bot: [alert] account=baz-service token_delta=+0.15% over baseline (1h) flagged for review. Link: https://console.internal/billing/alerts/ALRT-881

ana: Implementation sketch:
- ingest: ledger.write with meta fields (`credit_state=provisional`, `credit_reason=quota-trigger`)
- confirm path: when the canonical confirm event arrives (client ack / resume confirm), flip to `confirmed` atomically if provisional present
- dedupe: if a `confirmed` row exists for (session,offset), drop/ignore subsequent writes
- index: add compact index on (session,offset) and a secondary on (credit_state) for TTL job

mei: Add TTL job: provisional default TTL = 2h for quota-trigger (short) vs 6h for aggregator cases. After TTL expire, auto-confirm and mark `auto_reconciled=true` with reason `ttl_expire`. Finance can then reconcile.

rohan: Metrics to add: `billing.provisional.count`, `billing.provisional.flip_rate`, `billing.provisional.ttl_expiries`, and `billing.duplicate.drop_rate`. Also emit a `credit.signature` composed of sha256(session||offset||credit_reason||request_hash) to use as an alternative dedupe key.

casey: Good call on signature. We can generate request_hash at router time (covers route + policy) so both primary and secondary will produce same signature when the same client replay occurs — assuming resume_offset and original payload are identical. Caveat: if router alters metadata, signatures might differ.

ana: Rollout plan: feature flag `billing.provisional_credits=true`. Canary on 3% traffic for 24h, monitor `dup_rate` and the `flip_rate`. Console: add provisional/confirmed stacked area chart to the billing dashboard. Also add a canary banner for Finance with quick query links.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started: billing.provisional_credits@canary-3pct by hana, trace=depl-2026-03-21-0142

mei: QA tests:
- simulate quota-trigger then immediate retry; ensure only 1 final confirmed credit
- simulate router region swap with mismatched metadata; ensure signature-based dedupe still effective or fallback to index flip
- load test index with high write rates to ensure no perf regression

rohan: Backwards compat: older consumers of billing stream expect immediate counts. We'll need to version the billing export (`billing.schema.v2`) and provide both provisional and confirmed fields until finance migrates.

casey: Refund policy: if we detect duplicate confirmed credits historically, finance wants a report and retro adjustments. Let's include a query to find confirmed duplicates with matching signature in the last 90 days.

ana: I'll own the PR for provisional write plumbing + TTL job. mei will own router signature change. rohan can do index migration + tests. casey will coordinate with finance for reporting and customer-facing notes.

casey: Filing ticket INF-2026-624. Added repro harness and sample traces. Will paste PR links when ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
